Tell us what happened.

Use the feedback form for questions, ideas, and bug reports. No account is needed.

For a bug report

Include the Typefield version, your macOS version, what you did, what you expected, and what happened. Steps that reproduce the issue are especially useful. The form asks for them when you choose Bug report.

For a reply

Add your email to the form if you would like a reply. Email is optional. The form accepts text only, so please do not send font files, passwords, or other sensitive information.
